name: Sex or gender
description: Sex- or gender-based audience classifications. The new AdCP 3.3 core demographic gender predicates map to this attribute, including female, male, and non_binary. Existing provider-declared attributes retain their meaning. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 as part of media_buy.gender_targeting; the 3.2 registry is unchanged.
includes: Signals with authoritative gender demographic predicates
excludes: Sex-life or sexual-orientation meaning is not implied by the new core gender predicate; existing provider declarations remain authoritative
guidance: Available in AdCP 3.3. Applies to the new core gender predicate and signals carrying demographic_predicate.gender, regardless of the selected values or unknown membership. All core gender values receive the same attribute classification; the predicate alone does not imply sexual orientation. Adding the predicate MUST NOT remove or rewrite existing provider-declared restricted_attributes, including sex_life_sexual_orientation. The attribute does not by itself prohibit targeting or establish a legal classification. Evaluate applicable plan and seller policy restrictions against effective targeting, including inherited product defaults and preserved package constraints. Existing policy-category restriction lists and the sex_life_sexual_orientation definition are unchanged.
